raw:
US-10-03 is implemented and committed on `feature/US-10-03`, which branches off local `main`. All six of the story's test cases (TC-10-20…TC-10-25) pass in the run on the head commit (5508bce). The gates are green.

How it works:
- **Meet:** the model's answer can now say Meet was asked for, refused or not mentioned (DEC-223). The description's word on Meet wins. When it says nothing, Meet turns on with the first guest, as in the editor.
- **Which window:** a description with guests or Meet opens the full editor. One with neither, or one that only refuses Meet, opens the "New event" window.
- **Guest lookup:** for a Google calendar while online, each name is searched the way the guest field searches, followed by the recent guests. The box shows "Reading…" until Google answers, and Esc drops the answer (DEC-224). For a local calendar, offline, or without an account, nothing is looked up and the names are left out. A local calendar gets no Meet either.
- **Unresolved names:** a name that fits exactly one person invites that person. Any other name waits under the guest field with its own suggestions ("No one found" when nobody fits) and a remove button. It invites nobody until the user picks someone (DEC-225).

**Review finding:** the spec-compliance reviewer said every criterion is met, with one blocking finding: the edge case "an account that cannot add Meet → the switch stays off and unavailable, as in the editor today" is neither built nor tested. The editor today never greys the switch out. It offers Meet on every Google calendar, and when Google makes no call the event is saved without one and the user is told. I kept that behaviour, built nothing new, and recorded it as DEC-226. Whether the editor should grey the switch out is a question for the analyst. Code review may raise it again.

Paths are relative to `/home/sulo/workspace/private/calendar-buddy`. The new tests are in `crates/app/src/description_guests_tests.rs`, and DEC-223…226 are at the end of `docs/specs/DECISIONS.md`. A new preview picture, `editor-unresolved-light`, shows the editor with unresolved names (rendered to `target/preview/editor-unresolved-light.png`), for the owner's manual check.
